messages:
Maya (SE): Heads-up: Acme POC failing on function-calls + json_mode — parser errors and intermittent 429s. Need quick triage.
Ethan (AE): Demo scheduled tomorrow, customer blocked. Any hotfixes?
Maya (SE): Log: `JSONDecodeError: Expecting value` — sometimes payloads come double-escaped like `\"result\": {...}`.
Riley (Eng): Are you streaming? stream + strict json_mode often yields partial frames that break parsers.
Maya (SE): Yes, stream=true.
Riley (Eng): Quick fixes: disable streaming for the POC, set `json_mode: "relaxed"` if available, and cap `max_output_tokens` to avoid mid-object truncation.
Maya (SE): Snippet to share?
Riley (Eng): `{"call": {"name": "extract_entities"}, "json_mode": "relaxed", "max_output_tokens": 512, "stream": false}`
Ethan (AE): About 429s — headers show `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0` + `retry-after: 15`. Can we promise uptime?
Devon (SRE): It's bursty test traffic. Recommend client exponential backoff with jitter (start 500ms, cap 10s). Retries increase billed requests. For demos we can open a short capacity bump if you provide expected QPS/time window.
Maya (SE): Customer worried backoff = extra cost. Any mitigation?
Ethan (AE): Advise caching repeated prompts, reduce tokens, or Dedicated for predictable throughput/committed capacity.
Nora (Security): Acme also asked about logs/KMS and tenancy. Hosted logs retained 30 days; Dedicated/Private support KMS and private control plane. I'll prepare an SQA note.
Maya (SE): They want schema validation to avoid feeding invalid JSON to downstream services.
Riley (Eng): Run client-side JSON Schema validation (e.g., ajv) before ingest. Also check for simple envelope sanity: payload starts with `{` and ends with `}` when not streaming.
Maya (SE): They got outputs like `OK:\n{...}` and double-escaped blocks due to embedding JSON inside another JSON string.
Riley (Eng): Avoid double-serializing. Send function args as native objects. If you must sanitize, find first `{` and last `}` and parse, but that's brittle. Better: instruct model to return only the JSON object and use stop tokens.
Ethan (AE): Can we fast-track Dedicated review?
Devon (SRE): I can request a temporary quota bump (#DC-4321) once you provide channel, date/time window, and expected RPS.
ops-bot: Deploy request created (#DC-4321) — tagged @Devon.
Maya (SE): Applying relaxed json_mode + disabling stream fixed the parsing for the demo. Will draft a runbook with snippets, retry guidance, and the SQA note and post to #sales-docs.
Ethan (AE): Please cc me on the capacity ticket.
Devon (SRE): Will follow up on the ticket.
Maya (SE): Closing: demo passed after changes. Customer requested written runbook and a short-term capacity bump; I'll follow up.
